text: うーん…　よっぱらってた　みたいじゃ！

structure.jp: よっぱらってた　みたいじゃ！

patterns.name: 〜みたいだ
patterns.span: よっぱらってた　みたいじゃ
patterns.explanation: みたいだ after a sentence says 'it looks like that is so'. よっぱらってた みたいじゃ = 'it seems I was drunk'.

patterns.name: 〜ている
patterns.explanation: てた is the short spoken form of ていた, which tells the state someone was in. よっぱらってた = 'was drunk'.

patterns.name: 〜だ
patterns.explanation: じゃ is the old-man way of saying だ, 'is'. みたいじゃ = 'it seems so'.
